37952131.reason: The signal counts all-cause adverse-event discontinuations rather than gastrointestinal events; AACT serious gastrointestinal diagnoses do not supply the deduplicated all-GI endpoint.
37952131.source_span: Adverse events leading to permanent discontinuation of the trial product occurred in 1461 patients (16.6%) in the semaglutide group and 718 patients (8.2%) in the placebo group (P<0.001).
